entries.subject: Radius, mass and temperature
entries.finding: Radius 1.17 +/- 0.02 solar radii from Kunovac Hodžić et al. 2021, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of pi Men c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.502.2893K/abstract); Mass 1.07 +/- 0.04 solar masses from Kunovac Hodžić et al. 2021, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of pi Men c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2021MNRAS.502.2893K/abstract); temperature from Kunovac Hodžić et al. 2021, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of pi Men c in the NASA Exoplanet Archive.

entries.subject: Limb darkening
entries.finding: The disc is dimmed toward the limb by the quadratic law Claret & Bloemen (2011), A&A 529, A75 compute from ATLAS model atmospheres for the Johnson V band at 5,998 K and log g 4.33 (u1 0.414, u2 0.287): a model, because no fit of this star's limb is used.
